actions.name: Machine inspection and paytable verification
actions.key_assumption: Chance the inspection finds and fixes a paytable fault (30% / 70% / 95%); a fix restores the $200/day gap between theo and actual house win.
actions.breakeven: Pays back if the fix probability exceeds 21%.
actions.measurement: Before/after hit rate and hold vs game_math on the machine meters; expect hit rate back near 31.5% and hold near 10.0%. Also track its occupancy, since frequent small hits may be why players like it.
actions.uncertainty: The anomaly is certain (z > 100); the cause and whether a fix holds are not.
actions.note: Continuing the anomaly costs about $73,000 a year.

actions.name: Relocate one machine
actions.key_assumption: Moved machines earn the Center Pit's location factor (1.13 vs Back Forty 0.65, so x1.73) and B40 neighbours absorb 0% / 25% / 50% of the play they leave behind; low case assumes only a quarter of the location gap transfers.
actions.breakeven: Pays back if a moved machine earns more than 1.18x its Back Forty theo with no absorption.
actions.measurement: Moved machines' theo per available hour vs their own April-June Back Forty rate; rest of the pit vs control zones (the same test that showed bank B-51 did not cannibalize the pit); B40 remaining machines vs control.
actions.uncertainty: Location factors are averages; the new bank B-51 added play without cannibalizing the pit (+0.4%), which supports the mid case.
actions.note: Uses the two empty Center Pit slots; more moves would need swaps.

actions.name: Property promotion weekend
actions.targets: Weekend Jul 18-20 (earliest holiday-free weekend after the lead time; forecast coin-in $4,742,956, June-level $4,582,457)
actions.key_assumption: Lift equals the property's own past promotions: Locals Week +6.1%, average +11.8%, Winter Tournament +17.4%, applied to the July forecast (June's level in the low case) at the floor theo hold (9.46%), less comp reinvestment.
actions.measurement: Actual weekend coin-in vs the frozen July forecast and its 80% daily band; the following week vs forecast to catch pulled-forward play. Exclude the heaviest-loss guests from direct invitations.
actions.uncertainty: Two past promotions only, both in cooler months; July demand is softer, so a smaller lift is plausible.
actions.note: Responsible-gaming guardrail: broad marketing, no targeting of heavy-loss players.

actions.name: Add one technician to a shift for 30 days
actions.key_assumption: An extra technician saves 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.25 hours per swing-shift fault (the high case equals the whole short-staffing penalty); 3.2 faults per day at $22.39 per down hour after substitution.
actions.breakeven: Would need 7.0 hours saved per fault.
actions.measurement: Repair time on the swing shift vs the April-June fully staffed baseline.
actions.uncertainty: Staffing returned to plan in June; the short-staffing penalty may not recur.

actions.name: Preventive maintenance sweep for one manufacturer
actions.key_assumption: Preventive maintenance cuts Ridgeline faults by 10% / 25% / 50%, saving lost theo and direct repair cost ($896/day combined), less 90 minutes of quiet-hour downtime per machine.
actions.breakeven: Would need a 44% fault reduction within 30 days.
actions.measurement: Ridgeline faults per machine-month vs the other manufacturers, before and after.
actions.uncertainty: No preventive-maintenance history in the data to calibrate the effect.
actions.note: Benefits continue after July; a stronger case over a longer horizon.

actions.name: Wayfinding and signage refresh for a zone
actions.key_assumption: Signage recovers 0% / 35% / 100% of the Back Forty's remaining post-renovation gap (-4.5%, about $461 theo per day).
actions.breakeven: Would need to recover 81% of the gap.
actions.measurement: Back Forty coin-in per machine and door-counter entries vs control zones.
actions.uncertainty: The remaining gap is small; the zone was already the weakest before the closure.

actions.name: Comp policy pilot with control group
actions.targets: Random half of card holders at the pre-May rate vs current rate
actions.key_assumption: No in-horizon cash benefit: the May change had no measurable effect on play or comp cost, so the pilot buys information about the $4,221,507 rise in latent points exposure.
actions.measurement: Visits, coin-in and redemptions per player, treatment vs control, by tier.
actions.uncertainty: A 25-day pilot may be too short to detect a small effect.
actions.note: Recommended as the next step once a slot frees up; incompatible with A-COMP-CHANGE.

actions.name: Change comp redemption rate floor-wide
actions.key_assumption: Reverting toward the pre-May rate would shrink latent points exposure, but May's change moved no measured outcome, so a blind floor-wide change has no evidence-based benefit within 30 days.
actions.measurement: Comp cost, redemptions and carded coin-in vs the ITS trend.
actions.uncertainty: A floor-wide change has no control group.
actions.note: Incompatible with A-COMP-PILOT; the pilot is the better-evidenced way to settle the rate.

actions.name: Relocate a whole bank
actions.key_assumption: Needs a whole empty bank position in a stronger zone; the floor has only scattered empty slots.
actions.breakeven: Not feasible on the June 30 floor.

actions.name: Expanded guest intercept survey
actions.key_assumption: Improves next month's decisions (why the Back Forty lags, comp awareness); no direct July return.
actions.uncertainty: The current survey is already monthly, with documented sampling limits.

actions.name: Replace a machine with a purchased new title
actions.key_assumption: Buying ten new machines costs more than the whole budget.
actions.uncertainty: 2 of the ten are already retired.

actions.name: Replace a machine with a leased new title
actions.key_assumption: A new leased title in the same Back Forty slot earns 0% / 30% / 100% more theo than the machine it replaces; the location stays the same.
actions.breakeven: Would need a 114% uplift per machine.
actions.measurement: Replaced machines' theo per available hour vs their predecessors.
actions.uncertainty: The waterfall shows these machines lose to game mix and location, which a new cabinet in the same slot does not change.

actions.name: Preserve budget
actions.key_assumption: Keep what the evidence does not justify spending.
